2. Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials

The paper that gives a number for lithium leaching is:

1. Perspectives on the relationship between materials chemistry and roll-to-roll electrode manufacturing for high-energy lithium-ion batteries

The number is 3 wt% after one week, as shown in Fig. 4a.

expect: ethylene glycol (cssc-2020): Li content 1.015 to 0.993 (p5.L65-68); Cyrene (susmat-2020): ether groups attract lithium, numbers only in Table S1, not in the text (p5.L19-26); water (ensm-2020): NMC 811 leached ~3 wt% Li after one week (p5.L62-63)
